clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Razorfen Kraul, Blueleaf Tubers grow hidden from the surface. Their rarity draws wealthy gourmands and traders from across the world.

Blueleaf Tubers grow beneath Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens. Dense roots and quilboar briars hide them from casual foragers. Though the ground is harsh, wealthy gourmands and traders across the world pay an exorbitant price for their distinct flavor.

In Ratchet, the goblin Mebok Mizzyrix devised a way to find the hidden roots. He trains native snufflenose gophers to scent tubers from fifty paces away. Guided by specialized command sticks, adventurers can unearth them before quilboar patrols catch wind of the intrusion.
